context_for_next_testing_agent: Action logging and revert functionality is fully operational. Key features verified: 1) Bonus ADD/SUBTRACT/RESET create revertible logs with before_state and document_query for composite keys. 2) Prize redemption status change and deletion create revertible logs. 3) Order status change, rollback, and deletion create revertible logs. 4) User deletion creates revertible log (password excluded). 5) Category deletion creates revertible log. 6) Revert endpoint correctly handles both existing documents (update) and deleted documents (re-insert). 7) LogsTab UI shows amber RotateCcw icon for revertible actions, modal shows 'Откатить изменение' button, stats show 'Можно откатить' count. 8) AdminOrdersPage shows 'Откатить' button for completed/processing/cancelled orders. 9) No duplicate logs due to SKIP_LOG_PREFIXES in middleware.
